content.text:
Three files call `resolveBoardScope`. Each imports it from `@/lib/leaderboard/resolve-scope`:

- `web/src/app/api/v1/board/route.ts` calls it at line 57 with `query.community` and `callerUserId`.
- `web/src/app/api/og/community/[slug]/route.tsx` calls it at line 103 with `slug` and `null`.
- `web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx` calls it at line 45 with `parsed.data.community` and `callerUserId`.

`web/src/app/global/page.tsx` only mentions the function in a comment. It reuses the community page and doesn't call it.

A search for `resolveBoardScope` and `resolve-scope` across the repo, excluding `node_modules`, `.git` and `.next`, found no test files that use it.

<files>
web/src/app/api/v1/board/route.ts
web/src/app/api/og/community/[slug]/route.tsx
web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx
</files>
